column1: ally§Two small parties allied to block the budget.§两个小党**结盟**阻挠了预算案。
aloof§The house stands aloof at the far end of the valley.§那座房子**孤立地**矗立在山谷的尽头。
alter§Nothing he said altered the committee's mind.§他说的话丝毫没有**改变**委员会的想法。
alteration§The building has survived four centuries with only one major alteration.§这座建筑历经四百年，只经历过一次**大改建**。
altruism§Biologists still argue about whether altruism can be inherited.§生物学家至今仍在争论**利他**行为能否遗传。
altruistic§The scheme is altruistic in name and commercial in practice.§这个计划名义上是**利他的**，实际上是商业的。
amalgam§Her method is an amalgam of fieldwork and archival patience.§她的方法是田野工作与档案耐心的**融合**。
amalgamate§Three villages amalgamated into one parish in 1908.§一九〇八年，三个村庄**合并**成一个教区。
amalgamation§The amalgamation left the town with two of everything.§这次**合并**让镇上什么东西都成了两份。
amass§Debts amass quietly while everyone watches the revenue.§人人盯着收入的时候，债务在悄悄**堆积**。
amateurish§The forgery was amateurish enough to fail on the paper alone.§这件伪作**粗糙**到光凭纸张就露了馅。
ambiguity§Legal drafting exists to remove ambiguity, and often adds it.§法律起草本是为了消除**歧义**，却常常增加歧义。
ambivalence§Ambivalence about the prize did not stop him accepting it.§对这个奖的**矛盾心情**并未妨碍他接受它。
ambivalent§The report is ambivalent where the evidence is strongest.§恰恰在证据最有力的地方，报告的态度最**含糊**。
ameliorate§Shelter belts ameliorate the wind but cannot stop it.§防风林能**缓和**风势，却挡不住风。
amend§He amended the figure twice and still got it wrong.§他把那个数字**改了两次**，还是错的。
amiable§An amiable disagreement is still a disagreement.§**和气**的分歧仍然是分歧。
amicability§Amicability between the two offices survived a change of management.§两个办公室之间的**和睦**在管理层更替后依然保持。
amicable§The two rivals remained amicable in public for thirty years.§这对对手在公开场合**友好相处**了三十年。
amorphous§An amorphous solid has no crystal structure at all.§**非晶态**固体完全没有晶体结构。
anachronistic§The rule is anachronistic but nobody wants to repeal it.§这条规定已经**不合时宜**，却没人愿意废止。
analogous§Her position is analogous to that of an editor without a printer.§她的处境**类似**于一个没有印厂的编辑。
anarchist§He called himself an anarchist and paid his taxes on time.§他自称**无政府主义者**，却按时纳税。
anatomy§The anatomy of the wing explains why the bird cannot hover.§翅膀的**构造**解释了这种鸟为何不能悬停。
anecdotal§Anecdotal reports had circulated for years before anyone measured anything.§在有人做出任何测量之前，**传闻**已流传多年。
anecdote§One anecdote is not data, however good the story is.§一则**轶事**不是数据，故事再好也不是。
animate§What animates the book is not the argument but the doubt.§让这本书**生动起来**的不是论证，而是怀疑。
animosity§There was no animosity in the refusal, only fatigue.§这次拒绝里没有**敌意**，只有疲惫。
annotate§An annotated copy sells for ten times the price of a clean one.§一册有**批注**的书售价是干净本的十倍。
anomalous§Three anomalous results were repeated and two held up.§三个**反常**结果重做后，有两个仍然成立。
anomaly§The anomaly turned out to be a decimal point.§那个**异常**最后查出来是一个小数点。
anonymity§Anonymity made the survey honest and useless in equal measure.§**匿名**让这项调查既诚实又同样地无用。
antagonist§In her account the weather is the real antagonist.§在她的叙述里，天气才是真正的**对手**。
antagonistic§The two theories are not antagonistic; they answer different questions.§这两种理论并不**对立**，它们回答的是不同的问题。
antagonize§He antagonized the one person who could have approved it.§他**得罪**了唯一能批准这件事的人。
antecedent§Every clause here has an antecedent somewhere in the 1890 charter.§这里的每一条款在一八九〇年的章程里都能**找到出处**。
anthropocentrism§Anthropocentrism is hard to notice from inside it.§身在**人类中心主义**之中，很难察觉它。
anticipate§The design anticipates a load twice what the bridge will ever carry.§这个设计**预留**的荷载是这座桥实际承受的两倍。
anticipation§Anticipation of the result changed how people read the evidence.§对结果的**预期**改变了人们解读证据的方式。
antipathy§A mutual antipathy kept the two departments efficient.§相互的**反感**反倒让这两个部门保持了效率。
antipode§What he calls freedom is the antipode of what she means by it.§他所说的自由与她所指的**恰恰相反**。
antiquarian§The society's antiquarian interests saved three buildings.§该协会对**古物**的兴趣保住了三座建筑。
antithesis§Slow, careful work is the antithesis of the culture they describe.§缓慢细致的工作与他们所描述的那种风气**正相反**。
apathetic§An apathetic audience is harder to win than a hostile one.§**冷漠**的听众比敌意的听众更难赢得。
apathy§Apathy at the top explains more than malice ever could.§高层的**漠不关心**比恶意更能解释很多事。
aphorism§He answered every serious question with an aphorism.§每个严肃的问题他都用一句**格言**作答。
aplomb§The pianist recovered from the mistake with aplomb.§钢琴家**从容**地化解了那个失误。
apolitical§There is no apolitical way to draw a boundary.§划定边界不可能有**不涉政治**的做法。
apologetic§She was apologetic about the delay and firm about the price.§她为延误**道歉**，在价格上却毫不让步。
appall§What appalled him was not the error but the shrug that followed.§让他**震惊**的不是错误，而是随后那一耸肩。
apparition§The apparition of a ship on the horizon was a mirage.§地平线上出现的船只**幻影**是海市蜃楼。
appease§Appeasing a bully is a strategy with a short shelf life.§**安抚**恶霸是一种保质期很短的策略。
apportionment§Apportionment of the costs took longer than the repair.§费用的**分摊**比修理花的时间还长。
apprehend§It took him a year to apprehend what the data actually meant.§他花了一年才**理解**这些数据真正的含义。
apprehensive§Teachers were apprehensive about a change nobody had explained.§对于一项无人解释的变动，老师们**心怀不安**。
approximate§This translation approximates the rhythm rather than the words.§这个译本**近似的**是节奏，而不是字句。
apt§Her comparison was apt and slightly unkind.§她的比喻**恰当**，也略显刻薄。
arable§Terracing turned a bare slope into arable land.§梯田把光秃的山坡变成了**可耕**地。
arbitration§Arbitration cost less than a week of the trial would have.§**仲裁**的花费不到庭审一周的费用。
arboreal§An arboreal walkway lets visitors see the canopy from inside.§**树冠**步道让游客可以从内部观察林冠。
arcane§The filing system was arcane and, once explained, elegant.§这套归档方式很**晦涩**，一旦解释清楚却很精妙。
archaic§Archaic spellings survive in place names long after speech has changed.§语音早已改变很久之后，**古体拼法**仍留存于地名中。
archetypal§The archetypal exam question asks you to compare two things.§**典型**的考题会让你比较两样东西。
archive§The archive occupies four rooms and one very cold basement.§这座**档案馆**占了四个房间和一个极冷的地下室。
ardor§His early ardor for the subject cooled into competence.§他早年对这门学问的**热情**，冷却成了熟练。
arduous§Learning the notation is arduous and takes about a month.§学这套记号很**费力**，大约要一个月。
aroma§An aroma of wet stone came up from the crypt.§地下墓室里飘上来一股湿石头的**气味**。
aromatic§The wood is aromatic when freshly cut and odorless when dry.§这种木材刚锯开时有**香气**，干透后就无味了。
